title: {{NAME}} and the Unicorn Cup Miracle
moral: When you cheer for others, the magic gets even bigger.

pages.content: {{NAME}} came to a beautiful field covered in rainbow flowers. In the middle was a glittering soccer pitch. Animals were gathered all around. A white unicorn stood at the centre of the field. She was getting ready for the big Unicorn Cup soccer match.
